protocol.paired: same world states and range-sensor random stream per seed
protocol.paired_difference_interval: two-sided 95% t interval over seeds of (treatment - baseline); descriptive seed-to-seed variation, not a generalisation claim

notes: Matching: one-to-one Hungarian assignment per timestamp with a 2.00 m Euclidean gate, preferring each object's previous track while it stays inside the gate.

identity_switches_distance_only and position_rmse_distance_only: the same metrics under distance-only matching, shown to expose how much the matcher choice matters (a continuity preference can pair an object with a farther track, which raises RMSE; distance-only picks the nearest).
Evaluated tracks: confirmed and coasting snapshots only; tentative and deleted tracks are excluded.
Recall denominator: every ground-truth object in every simulated frame.
Precision denominator: every confirmed/coasting track snapshot in every frame.

Class accuracy: matched samples whose track class estimate and ground-truth class are both known (not UNKNOWN); correct / classified. None if no sample qualifies, so a range-only run never reports a fabricated zero.

Duplicate track sample: an evaluated track left unmatched in a frame while a ground-truth object lay within the 2.00 m matching gate (the object was claimed by another track). A duplicate track is a confirmed track that was never matched in any frame and has at least one duplicate sample.
Coverage: matched position errors against the reported 2x2 covariance; 95% threshold chi2(2,0.95)=5.991.

MOTA = 1 - (misses + false positives + identity switches) / ground-truth samples (can be negative; None without ground truth). IDF1, IDP and IDR use the best global track-to-object pairing by co-occurrence within the matching gate. GOSPA (alpha=2, cut-off 2.0 m, p=1 and p=2) is the mean per-frame distance over frames, where each missed object or false track costs c^p/2.

track_fragmentation: total interruptions, i.e. frames where a matched object goes unmatched and is matched again later, summed over objects (None if no object was ever matched). identity_switches counts track ID changes between consecutive matched frames and is independent of gaps.

scenario.description: Moderate vision bearing bias of 0.015 rad (intended to pass the 1-DOF gate often) while range-bearing is unbiased.
scenario.hypothesis: A bias that passes the association gate will be fused and may degrade accuracy. This measures the trade-off between accepting more vision observations and introducing systematic error.
scenario.name: sensor_disagreement_within_gate
